mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset ( account_id, stock_code, quantity, purchase_amount, avg_price, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{quantity}, #{purchaseAmount}, #{avgPrice}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_price = (purchase_amount + VALUES(purchase_amount)) / (quantity + VALUES(quantity)), quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), purchase_amount = purchase_amount + VALUES(purchase_amount), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId, stock_code AS stockCode, quantity, purchase_amount AS purchaseAmount, avg_price AS avgPrice FROM asset WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode} FOR UPDATE
